title: Canonical V2 mission-ID allocation policy
goal: Define and prove the deterministic canonical V2 mission-ID sequence from repository evidence before any automatic allocation is permitted.
laws: Canonical primary mission IDs are exactly V2-NNNL where NNN is 000-999 and L is A-Z.
Revision IDs such as V2-001A.R are immutable history but never consume primary sequence positions.
The next primary ID is the immediate successor of the greatest canonical primary mission envelope present.
Letter succession is A through Z; Z rolls the numeric series forward and resets to A.
Missing earlier IDs are historical gaps and are never backfilled automatically.
Any malformed primary-looking mission filename, duplicate identity, numeric overflow, or target collision fails closed.
Allocation policy computes an ID only; it does not write a mission, activate work, or execute anything.
